summary: Keep published agent rosters and collection views available when a graph-preserving local trim finishes, including the initial bounded roster head. Release history-dependent reductions without withdrawing presentation generations; telemetry fixtures wait on collection publication events rather than another list's readiness or retired checkpoint claims.

replay.detail: No replay changes; replaced projections still invalidate their publications.

rules.detail: Retention rules and graph-equivalence checks are unchanged.

downtime.detail: Local trim completion no longer temporarily withdraws graph-equivalent lists.

manual.detail: No configuration or operator action required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or new swap-back restrictions.
